title: BedwarsBetter
description: Team markers for Bedwars. Press R to place a beacon beam visible only to teammates. Works on any server!
body:
⚡ Bedwars Better — Ultimate Team Communication Mod

 

Ever wished your teammates could see exactly where you want them to go?

Bedwars Better adds tactical markers that are visible only to your team!

 

✨ Features:

 

📍 Precise Coordinates — Mark any block with exact X, Y, Z positions

🌐 Hybrid Sync — Works through chat (no server mods needed!)

📡 Universal Compatibility — Works on ANY server, even without mods

👥 Team-Only Vision — Enemies can't see your tactics

🎨 Auto Team Colors — Beams match your team color automatically

👁️ 3D Beacon Beams — Glowing pillars visible through walls

📝 Floating Text — See coordinates hovering above markers

🧹 Auto-Cleanup — Old markers disappear after 60 seconds

 

🎮 How to Use:

 

1. Press [R] while looking at a block

2. A colored beam appears instantly

3. All teammates see the same marker

4. Look at the marker to see distance and owner

 

🔥 Perfect for:

 

· Bedwars strategies

· Raid planning

· Resource marking

· Defense coordination

· ANY team-based game mode!
